headline: Space Bunny keeps climbing; two fresh faces join the ranks
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha extended its all-time token-share record to 29.5% for a third consecutive day, while two new entrants—dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview and mistralai/mistral-nemo—debuted in the top 50. DeepSeek remains firmly in second at 21.0%, but the top two providers now command 50.5% of the market between them.
highlights: stealth/space-bunny-alpha: 29.5% token share, day 3 of record streak
